proof_scope: Tau Discord human-decision receipts for repair overlays

claims.proves: Tau can attach Discord human-question state to a repair overlay, keep read-only status receipts from unblocking decisions, and validate a typed answer receipt against question_id, run_id, node_id, goal_hash, and allowed answers.
claims.does_not_prove: Discord network delivery, repair completion, provider semantic quality, or human acceptance of the repaired output.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Discord collaboration state is typed and can unblock only through a matching answer receipt, not through status text.
